title: FSLDataset fingerprint missed sequence_length / bos_token_id — wrong cache reused
trigger_conditions: NumpyPaddedFSLDataset / NumpyPackedFSLDataset / NumpyInterleavedFSLDataset cached on disk
subsequent run with different sequence_length/bos_token_id but matching pre-existing fingerprint
root_cause: fingerprint_fields for several FSLDataset variants did not include sequence_length, bos_token_id, max_target_sequence_length. Cached instance offsets / packed indices computed under the previous values were reused when those settings changed, so the dataset returned instances whose actual layout no longer matched the configured sequence_length.
invariant: Every dataset attribute that influences the on-disk cache layout must appear in fingerprint_fields so a config change invalidates the cache.
diff_summary: Add 'sequence_length' (and 'max_target_sequence_length', 'bos_token_id' where relevant) to fingerprint_fields for NumpyPaddedFSLDataset, NumpyPackedFSLDataset, and NumpyInterleavedFSLDataset.
silent_check: Buggy run loads the stale cache without raising — instance offsets are valid; the trainer simply gets instances whose lengths match the previous sequence_length, reading and training without any exception.
